label: Paste your own
demo_job: The closer. An empty template so anyone can paste one of their own emails and watch it go through the same pipeline on the same models — which is the moment the demo stops being ours and starts being theirs. It carries no content, so `bench/driver.py` skips it (`placeholder: true`) rather than benchmarking an empty request: the handler rejects an email with neither body nor subject with a 400, and counting that as a request would understate achieved RPS and pollute the application-error bucket.
